children: Glucotrack provided a strategic update highlighting near-term LT-100 clinical plans and growth of its ai² discovery and talent platform.
Announced LT-100 as immediate priority; clinical protocol submitted and study initiation targeted pending regulatory feedback.
Planned LT-100 trial will assess once-weekly subcutaneous dosing versus historical 15 weekly intradermal injections for knee OA pain.
Glucotrack completed a strategic business combination July 14 and now operates Lōkahi Therapeutics while Glucotrack Technologies remains a funded subsidiary.
ai² platform applied to >12,000 decommissioned programs, identified 45+ assets in year one and engages 14+ university and industry partners.
ai² includes Pipeline (asset ID/eval), Talent (student development) and Accelerator (early-stage initiatives like Qare) to convert opportunities into assets.

title: Glucotrack issues strategic update: LT-100 clinical study targeted, ai² platform expands university network
